status: NOTE to the training registration, not an exploratory arm. It changes no prediction, no criterion and no arm. It fixes how three registered items are read for arm C, whose even-only code sets the existing summary script cannot score.
instruction: The registration says the controls are run by the existing analyzeBoundaryHarmonicTraining11x11.py. That script scores contiguous code sizes only: it skips every restart file whose orders are not 0..N. Arm C is made only of even-only sets, so its G2 and C1 cannot be produced as registered unless the script is extended. This note fixes the reading before anyone looks at arm C.

changes.G1 for arm C: read exactly as for the other arms: a restart is formed when the overlap of its saved best pattern with the 54 flank cells is >= 0.9, from the restart files themselves.
changes.G2 and C1 for an even-only set: 'code size' in the registered G2 and C1 is read as 'code space'. For an even-only set (arm A and B's {0, 2}; arm C's {0,2,4,6}, {0,2,...,10} and {0,2,...,20}) the 64 random allowed codes are drawn (hit-and-run, as for the contiguous sizes) from that set's own code space at the arm's ceiling, scored by the same function as in training, and G2 is read against the best of them and C1 against the largest random overlap. They are computed for every even-only set that has a restart with overlap >= 0.9, because G2 and C1 only matter for a code that qualifies.
changes.implementation: a flag --orders (a comma-separated list; default: off, which reproduces the present behaviour exactly) of analyzeBoundaryHarmonicTraining11x11.py. With it the script reads only the restart files whose orders equal the list, builds the cosine basis from those orders, and then does everything it does for a contiguous size: the best restart, the 20,000-iteration run, the neighbours and the random codes. The summary is written with its own tag. The default run is checked to give the same summary as before the change on the single stripe's pilot folder (V4).
changes.D4: read as registered, on contiguous sizes. The odd coefficients of an even-only code are zero by construction and are reported, not scored.
changes.D6: the 20,000-iteration run of the primary code; if the primary code is even-only, it comes from the summary run with --orders.
changes.D7 and D8: the replays of analyzeBoundaryHarmonicFieldRole11x11.py on the primary code, as registered.
changes.scoring: a per-target copy of the single stripe's scoring script, analyzeBoundaryHarmonicDoubleStripesTrainingPredictions11x11.py, reads every restart of arms A, B and C, applies D1-D8, G1, G2 and C1-C3 as registered and this note, and is run once, after the summaries and the replays exist.

reportingRules: Anything beyond the registration and this note is labelled exploratory. If arm C's {0,2,...,20} set forms the pattern and the control cannot be built, the gate is reported as G1 met and G2 unscored, not as met.
